These are proved/scoped input boundaries, not proof that this prospective algorithm works. For public odd N, define a0=ceil(sqrt(N)); for a declared public modulus M and supported residue set R_N, define prefix survivors S_N(U)={0<=t<=U : (a0+t)^2-N meets the declared local QR conditions modulo M}. Preserve exact N-dependent residues and coupled CRT relationships, with gcd(N,M)>1 handled as a separately charged factor-revealing branch. Use only public N and predeclared public parameters; hidden factors/true T are verifier-only. Do not assume prime-power coverage from the existing squarefree-odd theorem. tasks.hard_target_and_required_outputs: 1. Define exact rank_N(U)=|S_N(U)| and select_N(k) (domain, indexing and absent-answer behavior), modulus/prime selection and all admissible inputs. Provide one concrete deterministic implicit CRT/MITM algorithm or an exact obstruction to the proposed representation; prove soundness, completeness, no duplicate survivors and exact rank/select or clearly delimit the supported query. 2. Derive a complete paid bit/arithmetic/space cost ledger: input size, public prime/modulus construction, local root extraction, gcd checks, CRT basis, preprocessing, storage, sorting/merging, prefix queries and candidate certification; charge per-instance work, and separate any justified amortized regime. Do not treat T, hidden factors, a presieved survivor list, a free table or batch certification as a free input. 3. Perform an actual primary-source prior-art/duplication comparison against known QR-wheel/CRT/MITM/Fermat constructions using the same cost model and prefix/output conventions. State exactly what is duplicate and what information or cost gap remains. 4. Prove either a scoped paid-cost advantage/boundary against the matched comparator, a lower/obstruction bound, or an explicit unresolved boundary. A fully explicit full-period table lower bound alone does not bound implicit CRT. Any small exact verification is supplementary and must be newly authorized after claim/open; no old 600-case benchmark, fixed-M proof checker or prior census replay.

tasks.success_kill_and_return_criteria: PASS only for the exact proven algorithm/obstruction and paid matched-comparison scope actually delivered; positive factorization benefit additionally needs its own complete justified claim and is not automatic. NEGATIVE_BOUNDARY/PARTIAL is valid when a specific representation or cost advantage fails: preserve counterexample/obstruction, scope, unresolved residue and no-repeat instructions without claiming all algorithms fail. Kill exact duplicate work after primary-source/control evidence identifies the existing solution or Task. A merely faster uncharged query after a free full-period table is not success. A finite experiment alone is not a uniform algorithm/cost theorem. Return a self-contained proof, pseudocode, cost ledger, primary-source comparison and immutable artifact pointers for genuine later review. Do not claim, run, freeze or review under the identity of the previous author. Prospective Task publication itself grants no execution; a real authorized researcher must own its claim/open before new computation.
